msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia la-vera-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a brown tweed check riding jacket over a cream ruffled-collar blouse, with beige riding trousers from the reference, walking at a sandy street of El Rocío, Almonte, Huelva, Spain, with white houses, wooden hitching rails and the marshes in the background, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia la-vera-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an olive green double-breasted waistcoat over a white shirt with a printed silk neckerchief, with a long green skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia la-vera-36.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a cream double-breasted waistcoat with a pleated peplum and brown buttons over a white shirt, with a camel skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia la-vera-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a beige gingham shirt with small embroidered yellow flowers, with brown trousers and a leather belt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia la-vera-33.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown shirt with cream western embroidery on the chest, with beige trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
